title: .svc/feature-graph.json — relational product-artifact store (WI-390)
description: The canonical relational index wiring story→AC→journey-scenario→test→task→persona. AC nodes carry a file_anchor POINTER to the prose AC text, NEVER a copy — the spec stays the authoritative prose store. Coverage matrices are rendered VIEWS of this graph (render-coverage-matrix.mjs), not hand-maintained.

generated_from.description: the spec path this graph was built from (v1 single-spec, svc-native)

file_anchor.description: POINTER of the form <path>:<line>. An AC node MUST have one and MUST NOT carry a prose text/description/body copy (AC1).

orphans.description: @AC-ID tags with no matching AC node — a build emits these and validate fails on any (AC2).
